programme.title: Vecinos

programme.title: Vecinos

programme.title: Vecinos

programme.title: Vecinos

programme.title: Vecinos

programme.title: Vecinos

programme.title: Vecinos

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: Offline with Jon Favreau
programme.sub-title: Offline with Jon Favreau (Winning Is Fun. Let’s Try It Again.)
programme.desc: A blue wave swept America on Tuesday, but where is it headed? Jon sits down with top campaign advisor Morris Katz to talk about what lessons Democrats should take away from the midterm landslide, why the progressive vs. moderate debate is misguided, and how Republicans got impaled on their own culture war sword. Morris worked on several midterm campaigns—including Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa’s—and he shares what he learned in the races he helped win: what made the best campaign ads break through? Is the Democratic Party more united than it seems online? And what should Democrats take from all of this into 2028—besides absolute certainty that whatever they already believed was right?

programme.title: Pod Save America
programme.desc: Live from DC, Jon, Lovett, Tommy, Alex, and Dan break down all the latest news from the aftermath of Democrats’ huge wins on Tuesday, from JD Vance’s attempted break with Trump to what the incoming majorities’ top priorities should be. Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed drops by to talk about standing up to Donald Trump, building consensus on saving Americans’ health care, and his eye-opening caffeine regimen. Then, Gov. JB Pritzker outlines a plan for standing up for working Americans, why Elon Musk’s millions didn’t get results, and why Democrats shouldn’t unilaterally disarm in the redistricting fight. Then, Pritzker joins the hosts for a round of Two Takes and a Fake, featuring the right’s most outrageous reactions to the blue tsunami.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.sub-title: What a Day (Latino Voters' Rebuke of Trump)
programme.desc: Most midterm voters said that President Donald Trump’s own policies had smothered growth and driven costs even higher, according to the AP Voter Poll. But how did those economic concerns resonate with Latino voters? On today’s show, Jane speaks with New Jersey Democratic Representative Rob Menendez, Vice Chair of Policy for the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, about the Latino vote and what this week revealed.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.sub-title: What a Day (MAGApocalypse Now: It’s (Stephen) Miller Time)
programme.desc: President Donald Trump named Stephen Miller his new White House Chief of Staff, bidding farewell to Susie Wiles and guardrails. This is Trump’s latest reaction to the MAGApocalypse, aka the Blunami, of Tuesday’s midterm election. On today’s show, Greg Walters talks to Miles Taylor, founder of defiance.org – a civic club focused on countering Trump’s abuses of power – and former chief of staff at the Department of Homeland Security during Trump’s first term, about how Trump just shook up his plans for the next two years.

programme.title: Pod Save America
programme.sub-title: Pod Save America (What Happened on Tuesday?)
programme.desc: Live from Crooked Con, Dan sits down with leading Democratic strategists to break down the party’s historic midterm victory. The Bulwark’s Sarah Longwell, pollster Carlos Odio, and campaign strategists Rebecca Katz and Addisu Demissie discuss the tactics that finally flipped Texas blue, the new ways campaigns are thinking about advertising, and how the 2026 results will shape the 2028 Democratic presidential race. Then, Jon sits down with Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro to discuss his campaign, how the new Democratic majority can keep its voters’ trust, how the party should approach AI regulation, and the governor’s 2028 ambitions.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It
programme.sub-title: Lovett or Leave It (50 Year Wave)
programme.desc: Republicans try to keep their heads above water as that big Blue Wave crashes over America, baby. Meanwhile, Trump ignores the beam in his own eye, and the White House stocks up on frozen baby mice to feed new Chief of Staff Stephen Miller. On the show, New York City Councilman Chi Osse and Heather McGhee talk firsts, (hopefully) lasts, and I told you sos from the 2026 midterms, while Brad Lander rolls up his sleeves and digs into Democrats’ new priorities in Congress. The Rant Wheel spins and Lovett sprints, off the stage and into the crowd, to lib out with our incredible Crooked Con audience.

programme.title: Blood Trails
programme.sub-title: Blood Trails | S2 E3 | The Search for Bob Smith | Blood Trails S2 E2
programme.desc: Bob Smith stepped into the Maine woods on a November afternoon in 1997 and never came back. His wife heard a single gunshot. Then... nothing. What followed was the largest ground search in the history of the Maine Warden Service. Investigators found clues—a set of boot prints, a strange arrow in the dirt, even a dead moose nearby—but none of them led to Bob. As the search dragged on, rumors surfaced: out-of-state hunters who left early, a story about an accidental shooting, and people who may have known more than they said. Was Bob Smith the victim of a tragic accident… or something far more deliberate? Want more Blood Trails? programme.title: Blood Trails
programme.sub-title: Blood Trails | S2 E5 | Catching the Killer of Neil LaFave | Blood Trails S2 E4
programme.desc: On his birthday in 1971, Wisconsin game warden Neil LaFave went out to post “No Hunting” signs. He never came home. The next morning, searchers found his body buried in a shallow grave. The brutality stunned investigators: multiple gunshots, and a horrifying attempt to conceal the crime. Suspicion quickly centered on a young poacher with a history of conflict with LaFave. But proving it would take something new: one of the first wiretaps ever used in a Wisconsin murder case. What followed was a breakthrough that changed the investigation, and revealed just how far someone was willing to go to avoid getting caught. Want more Blood Trails? programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

programme.title: Sencillamente Maity Interiano
programme.desc: En este nuevo episodio, me siento a conversar con una mujer que está viviendo uno de los momentos más especiales de su vida: Migbelis Castellanos. Presentadora, modelo.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: El Dr. Fabián Sandoval repudia severamente las presiones gubernamentales para reducir la vacunación infantil, alertando que dichas medidas abrirán la puerta a letales epidemias.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: El reverendo Rubén Ortiz reafirma que el mensaje cristiano debe ser activamente pacificador y opuesto a intervenciones bélicas como el conflicto en Irán.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Javier Sierra denuncia la demencial asignación de fondos millonarios en Washington, como pintar el estanque de Lincoln, mientras la ciudadanía soporta altos índices de inflación.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Miriam Gimal argumenta que muchas conductas autistas responden a problemas médicos profundos como la inflamación y la disbiosis intestinal.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: 007 (Pierce Brosnan) pulls out all the stops in this adrenaline-pumping adventure when a shadowy billionaire (Toby Stephens) develops a diabolical weapon that could bring the world to its knees! Halle Berry, Rick Yune and Judi Dench also star.

programme.title: Casino Royale (2006)
programme.desc: Bond (Daniel Craig) pursues terrorist financier Le Chiffre (Mads Mikkelsen), leading to a showdown in a high-stakes poker game at the Casino Royale.

programme.title: Skyfall
programme.desc: Bond's (Daniel Craig) loyalty to M (Judi Dench) is tested as her past returns to haunt her when MI6 is attacked by a shadowy figure (Javier Bardem).

programme.title: GoldenEye
programme.desc: The effortlessly suave and sophisticated Pierce Brosnan makes his debut as Agent 007 in this rip-roaring espionage thriller that finds Bond faced with his deadliest enemy yet...an MI6 agent gone rogue (Sean Bean) who is intent on world domination!
